name: agentic-engineering
description: Agentic engineering kit: seven skills (context engineering, harness engineering, skill development, agent development, evals, sandboxing, fewer faster tests), most named by a short block a hook prints at the moment it applies; an agentic-engineer agent that starts with two of them loaded; and /new-agent and /new-skill, which write the file from the skill's template or hand your words to Claude with the skill loaded (a Claude Mod: needs CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_FUNCTION_HOOKS=1).

setup.summary: seven skills, an agentic-engineer agent, and /new-agent and /new-skill for building with agents
